skip.そうして|そうして: older form of そして; noted there
skip.じゃ|じゃ: short form of じゃあ; noted there
skip.ぐらい|ぐらい: voiced form of くらい; noted there
skip.ころ|ころ: unvoiced form of ごろ; noted there

明るい|あかるい.notes: The Tanos list has the typo 明い; corrected to 明るい.

開く|あく.notes: Intransitive: ドアが開く. Compare 開ける.

開ける|あける.notes: Transitive: ドアを開ける. Compare 開く.

あさって|あさって.notes: Kana spelling of 明後日 (v:明後日|あさって).

あびる|あびる.notes: Kana spelling of 浴びる (v:浴びる|あびる).

あまり|あまり.notes: Used with a negative verb. Kana spelling of 余り (v:余り|あまり).

ある|ある.notes: For things and plants; people and animals use いる. Kana spelling of 有る / 在る.

いい|いい.notes: Conjugates from よい: よくない, よかった.

よい|よい.notes: Base form behind いい: よくない, よかった.

行く|いく.notes: Irregular て-form: 行って, 行った.

いす|いす.notes: Kana spelling of 椅子 (v:椅子|いす).

一日|いちにち.notes: As ついたち it means the 1st of the month (v:一日|ついたち).

いちばん|いちばん.notes: Kana spelling of 一番 (v:一番|いちばん).

居る|いる.notes: Usually written in kana: いる.

要る|いる.notes: Godan despite the -iru ending: 要らない, 要ります.

いろいろ|いろいろ.notes: Kana spelling of 色々 (v:色々|いろいろ).

煩い|うるさい.notes: Usually written in kana: うるさい.

おいしい|おいしい.notes: Kana spelling of 美味しい (v:美味しい|おいしい).

大きな|おおきな.notes: Only directly before a noun: 大きな家.

お母さん|おかあさん.notes: Polite; speaking of your own mother to outsiders, use 母.

おじいさん|おじいさん.notes: The Tanos list files this under 伯父/叔父 (= uncle); corrected. Kanji forms お祖父さん / お爺さん are rarely needed at N5.

伯父さん|おじさん.notes: 叔父さん for a parent's younger brother; often written in kana: おじさん.

お父さん|おとうさん.notes: Polite; speaking of your own father to outsiders, use 父.

一昨年|おととし.notes: Also written in kana: おととし (v:おととし|おととし).

おなか|おなか.notes: Kana spelling of お腹 (v:お腹|おなか).

同じ|おなじ.notes: Takes no な before a noun: 同じ本.

伯母さん|おばさん.notes: 叔母さん for a parent's younger sister; often written in kana: おばさん.

おもしろい|おもしろい.notes: Kana spelling of 面白い (v:面白い|おもしろい).

終わる|おわる.notes: The Tanos list writes 終る, an older okurigana (v:終る|おわる).

終る|おわる.notes: Older okurigana of 終わる, as the Tanos list writes it; 終わる is standard.

帰る|かえる.notes: Godan despite the -eru ending: 帰らない, 帰ります.

かぎ|かぎ.notes: Kana spelling of 鍵 (v:鍵|かぎ).

かける|かける.notes: Kana spelling of 掛ける (v:掛ける|かける).

川|かわ.notes: Also written 河 for a large river.

かわいい|かわいい.notes: Kana spelling of 可愛い (v:可愛い|かわいい).

九|く.notes: Used in 九時 (くじ) and 九月 (くがつ); きゅう elsewhere.

嫌い|きらい.notes: Looks like an い-adjective but is a な-adjective: 嫌いな食べ物.

切る|きる.notes: Godan despite the -iru ending: 切って, 切らない.

きれい|きれい.notes: Kanji form 綺麗. Looks like an い-adjective but is a な-adjective.

来る|くる.notes: Irregular: 来ない (こない), 来ます (きます).

さ来年|さらいねん.notes: Also written 再来年 (the JMdict headword).

散歩|さんぽ.notes: The Tanos list gives the reading as さんぽする; する is the verb, not part of the reading.

四|し.notes: Used in 四月 (しがつ); よん is the usual reading (v:四|よん).

七|しち.notes: Used in 七時 (しちじ) and 七月 (しちがつ); なな elsewhere (v:七|なな).

字引|じびき.notes: Old-fashioned; 辞書 is the usual word.

閉まる|しまる.notes: Intransitive: ドアが閉まる. Compare 閉める.

閉める|しめる.notes: Transitive: ドアを閉める. Compare 閉まる.

十|とお.notes: Native count (ひとつ … とお); also ten years old.

しょうゆ|しょうゆ.notes: Kana spelling of 醤油 (v:醤油|しょうゆ).

知る|しる.notes: Godan despite the -iru ending; "I know" is 知っています.

好き|すき.notes: A な-adjective: 好きな色. The liked thing takes が: 犬が好きです.

せっけん|せっけん.notes: Kana spelling of 石鹸 (v:石鹸|せっけん).

掃除|そうじ.notes: The Tanos list gives the reading as そうじする; する is the verb, not part of the reading.

そば|そば.notes: Not the same word as そば (buckwheat noodles).

たいへん|たいへん.notes: Kana spelling of 大変 (v:大変|たいへん).

たくさん|たくさん.notes: Kana spelling of 沢山 (v:沢山|たくさん).

たぶん|たぶん.notes: Kana spelling of 多分 (v:多分|たぶん).

誰か|だれか.notes: The Tanos list pairs this reading with 誰; corrected to 誰か.

だんだん|だんだん.notes: Kana spelling of 段々 (v:段々|だんだん).

小さな|ちいさな.notes: Only directly before a noun: 小さな家.

ちゃわん|ちゃわん.notes: Kana spelling of 茶碗 (v:茶碗|ちゃわん).

疲れる|つかれる.notes: "I'm tired" is 疲れました / 疲れています.

とり肉|とりにく.notes: Also written 鶏肉 (the JMdict headword).

何|なん.notes: Read なん before d/n/t sounds and counters: 何ですか, 何時; なに elsewhere (v:何|なに).

賑やか|にぎやか.notes: Often written in kana: にぎやか.

温い|ぬるい.notes: Usually written in kana: ぬるい.

入る|はいる.notes: Godan despite the -iru ending: 入って, 入らない.

はく|はく.notes: Kanji form 履く (shoes) / 穿く (trousers).

はし|はし.notes: Kana spelling of 箸 (v:箸|はし).

走る|はしる.notes: Godan despite the -iru ending: 走って, 走らない.

半分|はんぶん.notes: The Tanos gloss "half minute" is wrong; 半分 just means half.

一月|ひとつき.notes: Read いちがつ it means January (a different word).

ふろ|ふろ.notes: Usually お風呂 (v:お風呂|おふろ).

勉強|べんきょう.notes: The Tanos list gives the reading as べんきょうする; する is the verb, not part of the reading.

曲がる|まがる.notes: The Tanos list writes 曲る, an older okurigana (v:曲る|まがる).

曲る|まがる.notes: Older okurigana of 曲がる, as the Tanos list writes it; 曲がる is standard.

見る|みる.notes: Also written 観る for watching films or shows.

行く|ゆく.notes: Older / written reading of 行く; いく is the everyday one (v:行く|いく).

ラジカセ|ラジカセ.notes: Short for ラジオカセット. The reference lists had the truncated ラジオカセ; corrected.

練習|れんしゅう.notes: The Tanos list gives the reading as れんしゅうする; する is the verb, not part of the reading.

余り|あまり.notes: Usually written in kana: あまり.

有る|ある.notes: Usually written in kana: ある.

在る|ある.notes: Usually written in kana: ある.

おととし|おととし.notes: Kana spelling of 一昨年 (v:一昨年|おととし).

面白い|おもしろい.alt: おもしろい|おもしろい

円|えん.notes: Used after numbers as the yen counter: 百円.

お|お.notes: The elzup list writes it お～; the ～ is not part of the word.

か月|かげつ.notes: Also written ヶ月 / カ月.

contexts: to complain of the cold (of someone else)
